rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a prediction or estimate made without firm evidence.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gu2 gai3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making an uncertain conjecture or supposition.

example.english: I guess he won’t come today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 lai4

rows.note: Use this, especially as 我諗, for “I guess” meaning “I think” or “I reckon” without stressing uncertainty.

example.english: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this when the conjecture turns out to be correct, such as guessing an answer or solving a riddle.

example.english: You actually managed to guess the riddle correctly.
example.jyutping: nei5 gu2 zung3 zo2 go3 mai4 jyu5 wo3
